1.text: Ariko wowe ho uvuge ibihuye n'inyigisho nzima.

2.text: Uhugure abasaza kugira ngo be gukunda ibisindisha, bitonde, badashayisha, babe bazima mu byo kwizera n'urukundo no kwihangana.

3.text: N'abakecuru ni uko ubabwire bifate nk'uko bikwiriye abera batabeshyera abandi, badatwarwa umutima n'inzoga nyinshi, bigisha ibyiza

4.text: kugira ngo batoze abagore bato gukunda abagabo babo n'abana babo,

5.text: no kudashayisha, no kwirinda gusambana, no kwita ku by'ingo zabo, no kugira neza, bagandukira abagabo babo kugira ngo ijambo ry'Imana ridatukwa.

7.text: wiyerekane muri byose nk'icyitegererezo cy'imirimo myiza, kandi mu iyigisha ryawe ugaragaze uko uboneye udapfa gutera waraza,

8.text: n'ijambo ryawe ribe rizima ritariho umugayo, kugira ngo umuntu uri mu ruhande rw'ababisha amware atabonye ikibi yakuvuga.

9.text: Hugura abagaragu b'imbata kugira ngo bagandukire ba shebuja, babanezeze muri byose batajya impaka,

10.text: batiba, ahubwo bakiranuke neza rwose kugira ngo muri byose bizihize inyigisho z'Imana Umukiza wacu.

11.text: Kuko ubuntu bw'Imana buzanira abantu bose agakiza bwabonetse,

12.text: butwigisha kureka kutubaha Imana n'irari ry'iby'isi, bukatwigisha kujya twirinda, dukiranuka, twubaha Imana mu gihe cya none

13.text: dutegereje ibyiringiro by'umugisha, ari byo kuzaboneka k'ubwiza bwa Yesu Kristo, ari we Mana yacu ikomeye n'Umukiza

14.text: watwitangiriye kugira ngo aducungure mu bugome bwose, kandi yuhagirire abantu kugira ngo babe ubwoko bwe bwite, bugira ishyaka ry'imirimo myiza.

15.text: Ujye uvuga ibyo kandi ubibahugure, ubahana nk'ufite ubutware rwose. Ntihakagire ugusuzugura.
